cases.excerpt: We studied the associations between selenium exposure and prostate diseases such as prostate cancer (PCa) and benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH), and estimated the optimal range of selenium concentrations that may be needed to prevent these diseases among Nigerian men. Blood and urine samples from men with histologically diagnosed PCa (n = 90), BPH (n = 97), and controls (n = 98) were analyzed for trace elements, including selenium.

effect_size.excerpt: Men in the lowest and highest blood selenium tertiles had increased odds of PCa {AOR (95% CI): 2.90 (1.13, 7.46) and 4.42 (1.68, 11.59), respectively}.
